sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Re-exports storage pieces
sections.what: Passes along the storage service, the not-found error, the shared client, the access helpers and the route registration function, so other code can import them from this one file.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Removing or renaming any of these exports breaks every file that imports them from here.

summary: A single doorway that re-exports the file storage pieces so other code can import them from one place.
purpose: Keeps import paths short and stable.
why: Likely reason: groups related pieces together. Not stated in the code.
how: 1. Re-exports the storage service, the not-found error and the shared storage client. 2. Re-exports the access types and helper functions. 3. Re-exports the route registration function.
inputs: None at run time. It only passes along other modules.
outputs: The same names as the files it collects.
risks: Importing this file loads the storage client and route code, so a setup problem in either shows up on every import.
debug: If an import fails, check that the named source file exists and exports that name. Missing-name errors usually mean something was renamed in one of the three source files.
